Title: Public Preview: High Scale mode for Azure Monitor – Container Insights

Body.Content:
Container Insights is Azure Monitor’s solution for collecting logs from your Azure Kubernetes Service clusters.

We are happy to announce the public preview of High Scale mode in Container Insights to help customers achieve a higher log collection throughput from their AKS clusters.  When High Scale mode is enabled, Container Insights does multiple configuration changes leading to a higher overall throughput. All the changes are made in the background by the service and do not require input or configuration from customers.

To get started with High Scale mode, please see our documentation.

Learn more.
